summary: Explain research steps through purpose, operation, observed judgment change and next action; assess comprehension by a reader who did not participate.
revisit: Apply at human-facing research delivery or UI preparation. Reuse existing narrative and records. This is a flexible explanation structure, not four mandatory fields or a new first-draft review round. Preserve scientific progress and existing reviewer acceptance; rerun only if new understanding changes a scientific obligation.
acceptance: Uninvolved reader can explain why a step was done, what happened and why the result matters without opening JSON. Agent reading and actual human feedback are recorded separately.
